learning_outcomes.text: Design, build and test an electronic product to a given specification.
Demonstrate a commitment to conduct engineering activities in a professional manner.
Research a topic, find relevant literature and produce a technical review.
Research a topic and write a project proposal.
Demonstrate an awareness of the importance of management in the context of engineering projects.

syllabus_topics: Complete a set of laboratory experiments
Observation, measurement and recording of experimental results
Presenting and reporting of results Professional Development
Institutional Code of Conduct Research Methods
assessment_rules: Assessment is demonstrated through a Portfolio of evidence, covering product development.
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering
